issue.title: gkeep pull re-pull reports show the journal-recovered reading parent

task_type_fields.proposal: Show the recovered parent in `bob gkeep pull` archive-only re-pull reports. bob-cli-5y.10 made the Keep journal's `ref_created` event store the chosen parent, and `Journal::ref_parent` recovers it (both covered by tests), so a re-pull never re-asks. But when a re-pull finds the ref already in the vault and only archives the Keep note, the human and JSON reports say "already in vault" without naming the parent (`→ sase`). Surface it the same way first-pull reports and `gkeep list` (`🔗 ref → sase`) do. Proposed by bob-cli-5y.10--1 note #5.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Outside the bob-cli-5y spec, which required only that the journal store the parent so re-pulls never re-ask. The reports stay accurate without it; this is display polish.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-5y.10--1 (note #5): the journal already recovers the parent, but archive-only re-pull reports never show it.
